svg.title: Gangnam Station: actual 400 m square building and road overview
svg.desc: Actual MOLIT GIS Building Integration footprints and OpenStreetMap background. 126 buildings, 83 with source-reported positive heights and 43 without usable heights. North is up; x and y are local metres. Orange footprints retain buildings with unknown height. Building names and explicitly tagged tunnels are not drawn. Road marks are centerlines, not road surfaces.
svg.text: Official building footprints and source heights · OpenStreetMap road centerlines
Buildings: MOLIT GIS Building Integration, provided by VWorld. Footprints projected and clipped to the 400 m AOI.
Local coordinates = EPSG:5179 coordinates minus the selected center.
